title: Cipher and Confession
author: Ines Ashgrove
blurb: Cyrus Eastwick, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
